title: Provider-neutral performance and reliability qualification

runtime: bounded offline evaluation of supplied observations

binding.observation: unique id, category, specification, and evidence digest

rules: Every category has one bounded numeric observation and an explicit comparison specification.
Qualification is evaluated against supplied observations only; no benchmark, provider, network, or LLM operation is performed.
live_measurement is always not_performed in this contract and cannot be inferred from supplied qualification.
Observation count, value range, and evidence payload are bounded before evaluation.
A passing result means supplied values satisfy supplied specifications, not that a live system is qualified.

privacy.allowed_values: bounded identifiers, categories, enumerations, finite non-negative numbers, and SHA-256 digests

failure_semantics.side_effects: The model and checker perform no benchmark, provider, network, LLM, process, Git, Coordinator, AWQ, AWG, UI, or durable-state operation.

limitations: A valid envelope proves only that bounded supplied values satisfy the stated comparisons.
Supplied qualification is not live measurement, host enforcement, provider behavior, or production reliability.
The checker does not reproduce a workload, verify measurement provenance, inspect resources, or validate external evidence.
follow_up: Coordinator remains authoritative for task revision, claims, leases, and durable state.
AWQ remains authoritative for requirements, gates, and acceptance of this evidence.
A future live harness must issue a distinct revision-bound measurement contract before collecting runtime data.
